title: artanthe barbata
intro: Artanthe barbata, commonly known as Indian shot or Chinese lantern, is a plant species that belongs to the family Menispermaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and various other health issues due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Artanthe barbata include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which help in alleviating pain, reducing inflammation, and lowering fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
